# Method IsInvalid

#### IsInvalid(ElementId)

Tells whether an element is invalid.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
bool IsInvalid(ElementId inElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the element to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  Whether the element is invalid.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
